verdict.rationale: Sill is a free, open-source Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming and remote-control app. A remote-access product could conceivably publish a programmatic API, so this axis applies. The evidence documents no public API or machine-readable spec, and probes for common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. Its build-from-source and CLI host options are developer building blocks, not a downloadable API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
